explanation: Dr. Arvind Panagariya was appointed as the Chairman of the 16th Finance Commission.
Viksit Bharat (2047), net-zero (2070), and TB elimination (2025) are official targets. There is no official ban on fossil fuel cars by 2030.
Viksit Bharat @ 2047 aims to make India a developed economy by the 100th anniversary of independence in 2047.
